proposal.summary: Stored cross-site scripting in Adive Framework 2.0.8 user add page allows an attacker to store a script that, when an admin visits the admin/user page, performs a CSRF-like request to change the admin password.
proposal.cwe_quote: Description : The parameter 'userUsername=' is vulnerable to Stored Cross-site scripting

UI.quote: when admin visits the /admin/user page the payload will trigger.

C.quote: As soon as admin will visit the page the payload will be triggered and the admin password will be changed to hacked@123

I.quote: As soon as admin will visit the page the payload will be triggered and the admin password will be changed to hacked@123

A.quote: As soon as admin will visit the page the payload will be triggered and the admin password will be changed to hacked@123

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vulnerable endpoint by reproducing the stored XSS in a test environment, confirm that a crafted script can perform state-changing requests as an authenticated admin, and then patch by properly encoding/escaping user-supplied input and adding CSRF protections on sensitive admin actions.
